messages:
emma: Hey folks, hitting duplicate resource creations from the async Python SDK when the client times out but the server still processed the request. Not sure the retry path is preserving idempotency headers. Repro details below.

 sahil: Oof. Is this the LLM streaming endpoints or a straightforward POST create?

 emma: Straight POST to /v1/resources (non-stream). Minimal example: 
```py
async with RedwoodAsyncClient(api_key=...) as c:
    await c.post('/v1/resources', json={'name': 't1'}, retry=RetryConfig(max_attempts=3))
```
Sometimes asyncio.TimeoutError happens, client retries, server already returned 200, then retry succeeds and a duplicate resource is created.

 dana: Are you adding an Idempotency-Key header or using an SDK helper param?

 emma: I tried both. When I set header explicitly it usually works but intermittently the retry request lacks the header. Logs show first attempt had `Idempotency-Key: x-123` and retry did not.

 luis: I think this is the transport refactor regression: the async transport converts body into an aiohttp payload and the retry logic reuses the request object, but the header generation was bound to the original lifecycle and isn't copied into the retry envelope. So header mutation + streaming body => lost header on replay.

 emma: Example log: 
```
client: starting request POST /v1/resources id_key=x-123
client: request timed out after 10s -> scheduling retry attempt=1 backoff=0.5s
client: resending request attempt=1 (no idempotency header present)
server: 200 Created resource id=r_456
client: retry succeeded -> returned 201 for new resource id=r_789
```

 sahil: Two things to fix: (1) ensure idempotency header snapshot is preserved across retries; (2) make request bodies rewindable or buffer them for retries, or avoid retrying non-idempotent POSTs unless key present.

 emma: Also noticed typing DX issues: RetryConfig.jitter accepts `Callable[[int], float]` but package __init__ exports RetryPolicy as `Any`, which breaks mypy. We should re-export `BackoffStrategy` and `RetryPolicy` from top-level to avoid folks importing from internals.

 luis: Transport plan: when initially sending, capture a shallow copy of headers and attach to request._retry_meta; on retries, rebuild outbound headers from that snapshot. For streaming bodies, detect `is_stream` and buffer up to N bytes (configurable) for small payloads; mark large streams as non-retriable unless Idempotency-Key present.

 emma: I'll add a pytest-asyncio integration to reproduce. Pseudo: 
```py
@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_retry_preserves_idempotency(async_client):
    await async_client.stub_server.enqueue_response(delay=11, status=200)
    await async_client.post('/v1/resources', json={'x':1}, headers={'Idempotency-Key':'abc'}, retry=RetryConfig(max_attempts=2, backoff=0.1))
    assert async_client.server.recorded_requests.count_with_header('Idempotency-Key') == 2
```

 dana: Please include exact SDK version. If this is a regression from the refactor we should target a 0.18.1 hotfix.

 emma: I'm on 0.18.0rc2. Also `RetryConfig.jitter` typing appears in stubs but top-level exports list `RetryPolicy: Any`. Small but big for strict mypy users.

 luis: OK actionable items: 
- [ ] transport: snapshot headers into retry meta (luis)
- [ ] transport: buffer small bodies; mark streams non-retriable by default (luis)
- [ ] API: export `BackoffStrategy` and `RetryPolicy` types at package top-level (sahil)
- [ ] add integration test + repro script (emma)
- [ ] docs: explicit idempotency guidance + quickstart snippet (dana)

 sahil: Also consider default retry policy: only retry POST when Idempotency-Key present OR user sets `retry.allow_post=True`. Safer by default and explicit opt-in. Same rule applies to transient 5xx and timeouts.

 emma: I'll add a small examples/reproducer in the repo so Support can triage customer cases quickly.

 ci-bot: build #8245 (pr/transport/retry-headers) started by luis 94 running tests

 replay-bot: note: 3 open customer incidents flagged duplicate-create; linking PR will help triage.

 luis: Opening a WIP PR with header snapshot change and changelog. Pushing now: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/1234

 emma: Verified locally against the patch 94 both attempts keep the same `Idempotency-Key` and duplicates stopped in my repro. Will run full test suite overnight. :thumbsup:

 sahil: After the patch lands, let's add a Quickstart note on async idempotency and call out the streaming caveat.

 dana: I'll update the docs and write the hotfix release note once PR is merged.

 emma: Thanks! I'll attach my failing logs and the new test to the PR.
